_comment: Base configuration for markdown-link-check. This file is the single source of truth and is used directly by .github/workflows/markdown-links.yml. On pull requests and pushes the workflow layers one extra ignorePattern on top of it, '^https?://', so that only internal links (relative paths and heading anchors) gate a merge; the weekly scheduled run and manual dispatches use this file as-is and do check external links. Edit this file to change link-checking behaviour -- it previously had no effect, because the workflow generated its own copy over the top.

ignorePatterns.comment: NIST NVD blocks automated requests via Cloudflare

_comment_aliveStatusCodes: 403, 429 and 999 all mean the server answered and declined this particular request. That proves the host resolves and is serving, which is the opposite of a dead link. 429 in particular was failing builds on docs.ansible.com despite retryOn429 above.
